CustomField.label: Integration User
CustomField.description: The Salesforce user record that this external system authenticates as when it connects to Salesforce, if the integration uses a dedicated integration user (as opposed to a named end-user's credentials). Knowing the integration user helps an admin trace API activity in login history and debug logs back to this specific Boundary Application.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The Salesforce API user this system authenticates as, if applicable.
